assertions: Doke and provider snapshots are normalized and deterministically fingerprinted.
Raw provider payloads and sensitive card data are rejected from reconciliation artifacts.
Divergences are classified without automatic financial mutation.
The operator queue fails closed without a server-side store adapter.
Only support/admin operators can triage; replay approval requires separation of duties.
Controlled replay requires unchanged fingerprint, signed-event evidence, idempotency and dry-run.
Replay commands cannot directly mutate payments, wallets, refunds or payouts.
Resolution requires a fresh matched comparison.
